reasoning_content: The client code looks complex - it uses Babylon.js for 3D rendering. If there's a runtime error in the client initialization, it would cause a white screen. Let me check if there's a specific error from the browser console by checking the build status of the client:

action.command:
cd /workspace/project && python3 << 'EOF'
import paramiko
client = paramiko.SSHClient()
client.set_missing_host_key_policy(paramiko.AutoAddPolicy())
client.connect("46.202.154.25", 22, "root", "2N00py123+++")

# Check if client dist exists
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("ls -la /opt/areloria/client/dist/ 2>&1 | head -10")
print("Client dist:", stdout.read().decode())

# Check vite errors in build
stdin, stdout, stderr = client.exec_command("cd /opt/areloria/client && pnpm run build 2>&1 | tail -20")
print("\nBuild:", stdout.read().decode())

client.close()
EOF
